name: Is it better to repair or replace damaged wood siding?

mainEntity.name: Is it better to repair or replace damaged wood siding?

acceptedAnswer.text: The decision to repair or replace damaged wood siding depends on the extent and severity of the damage. Minor issues like small cracks, isolated rot, or a few warped boards can often be effectively repaired by replacing individual sections. However, if the damage is widespread, covers a large percentage of your home's exterior, or indicates structural problems, a full replacement may be a more cost-effective long-term solution. A professional assessment can help determine the best approach.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor damage can be repaired, but widespread or structural issues may require full replacement. A professional assessment is recommended.
